function: Excluded, above_phy: MARL decides data partitioning, CPU frequency, and routing paths of digital FL aggregation over inter-satellite links (p. 8, p. 9).
notes: Exclusion above_phy (check 4): the MARL agents act on scheduling, edge computing and routing. p. 8: "This agent allocates computational resources and energy by adjusting the processing frequency" (the allocation agent sets the CPU frequency, not radio resources); p. 9: "This agent makes decisions on routing paths and whether to initiate aggregation". No learned physical-layer decision: p. 5: "the transmit power is a constant value Pv", and the laser link model only gives delays. FL aggregation is digital over inter-satellite links, not over the air, so it is not area 7 either.
